# Using nmcli to change a DNS server address

_Performed on a RHEL type system_

Using the command line, identify the interface/connection;
```

```

Then change the address of the DNS server;
```
sudo nmcli connection modify ens18 ipv4.dns "10.2.0.212"
```

The change will not come into effect until the interface/connection is reset, or the sytem is rebooted;
```
sudo nmcli connection up ens18
```

The resolve.conf file should now show the new address;
```
cat /etc/resolv.conf
# Generated by NetworkManager
search lab.local
nameserver 10.2.0.212
```
